Subject: Field capacity swap + compensation floor approval for strategic SE hire

Hi Marissa —

Quick background: Acme (large prospect; expected first-year ARR ~$950k) has indicated strong preference for a dedicated Solutions Engineer during the pilot. We have an excellent candidate (Nora Patel) in final-stage interviews via Talent Partner (Michael Yoon). Nora is currently at a competing vendor and requires a comp floor above the standard SE band for us to be competitive.

Proposal (asks):
- Move one unfilled AE headcount (North America field AE, open requisition REQ-987) to a Solutions Engineering seat for FY28 Q2 (seat swap).
- Approve a compensation floor for this candidate: base $155,000 + target OTE ~$220,000 (15k sign-on one-time). This is above the midpoint for SE band but below our external market stretch.
- Approve offer letter draft (attached) and 48-hour acceptance window once extended.

Why this is urgent:
- Acme's buying timeline is compressed; they asked for a technical partner in the next 3 weeks.
- Estimated incremental ARR and probability-weighted pipeline justify a targeted comp premium to secure the ramp.

Impacts and mitigations:
- Quota coverage: we will redistribute ACV targets across the regional AE pool; no new quota assigned until candidate ramps.
- Finance: will need budget reallocation between AE and SE lines; will loop in once headcount swap is approved.
- Candidate must clear reference and background checks as standard.

Attachments: comp-bands-q2-2028.xlsx (comp band guidance), offer-letter-draft-Nora-Patel.pdf

Ask: Can I get a yes/no on the seat swap + compensation floor by EOD so we can extend the offer tomorrow?

Thanks,
Jasmine

- SE band (region: NA) — base range: $115k–$145k; target OTE range: $165k–$205k.
- Approving a $155k base pushes the offer ~1 SD above our current band midpoint but within market for high-priority strategic closes.
- Sign-on of $15k is acceptable as a one-time exception for revenue-critical hires; recommend capping at $20k and documenting as exception.

Precedent: We approved similar exceptions for two strategic hires in FY27 Q4 (internal refs attached in comp-bands-q2-2028.xlsx).

Headcount tracker impact: I can move the AE requisition to SE internally and mark as "seat swap pending"; Finance will need a P&L reclass note.

- Recommend we get explicit sign-off from Finance (cc'd Laura) for budget reallocation before offer is sent.
